title: Self-Consistent Motion of Massive Charged Particles in Relativity
exact_target: Develop a mathematically consistent coupled description of massive charged particles and their electromagnetic and gravitational fields.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004806 (OWR-8415343-009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The report asks for a modelling framework, not a uniquely specified existence theorem. A distributional class, regularization and notion of particle motion must be stated in any proposed solution.
